plan: [This is a single-round, second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid = my private value) is a dominant strategy: I never pay my bid but the second-highest price, so bidding my value maximizes expected profit and avoids overpaying. My private value is $3, so I will bid $3.00.]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction the dominant strategy is to bid my true private value. Bidding my value (or truthfully) maximizes expected profit and avoids the risk of overpaying. There is only one round and no prior history to exploit, so I will bid $24. ]

[I will bid my true valuation ($11). In a second-price auction bidding your value is a dominant strategy: you win when the second-highest bid is below 11 and then pay that price, yielding nonnegative profit; bidding differently cannot improve expected payoff given independent draws. No history to exploit.]
